The igitz were a popular pet in most Gungan civilizations and this lead to the species becoming present on other worlds. The igitz sits upright on its haunches on thick folded hind legs with webbed feet, its short clawed forelimbs propped in front, and a finned tail behind. prompt: mastiff phalone: A large, long-bodied four-legged avian predator of the Maridun savannas, built like a griffin: a coat of grey feathers barred with dark blue, a mane of dark feathers over neck and shoulders, and a long feathered tail.
